The protected supervisor must supply consistent full identities. The prefreeze wire binds operation, intent, task, SourceInput and original trust/peer evidence; it does not independently compare every fleet/workspace/resource field.
Material Ready precedes the five services and establishes only pair creation or recovery and consumption of the same Source. It does not establish service, Adopt, consumer C, or task success.
External signed trust material, independent Outcome, Evaluator, actual service peers and the supervisor four-frame driver must be supplied by real authorized participants.
Recovery does not append a new Experience or convert read permission into Execute authority. Earlier durable effects may remain after an error.
Original synchronous owner/storage I/O and joined service threads do not establish a physical exit deadline.
